shortDescription: Cooler Master MasterLiquid Core NEX 360 Digital AIO CPU Liquid Cooler (Real-Time Digital Temperature Display / 360mm Radiator / Triple ARGB PWM Fans / 400mm Sleeved Tubing / Intel LGA 1851 1700 & AMD AM5 AM4 Ready /
descriptionHtml:
Cooler Master MasterLiquid Core NEX 360 Digital AIO CPU Liquid Cooler (Real-Time Digital Temperature Display / 360mm Radiator / Triple ARGB PWM Fans / 400mm Sleeved Tubing / Intel LGA 1851 1700 & AMD AM5 AM4 Ready / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Take full control of your CPU thermals with cutting-edge real-time monitoring through the Cooler Master MasterLiquid Core NEX 360 Digital AIO Liquid Cooler, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Featuring an integrated Digital Screen on the pump cap, this high-performance liquid cooler delivers live system statistics while utilizing a redesigned dual-chamber pump for rapid coolant flow. Backed by a large 360mm aluminum radiator, durable 400mm sleeved tubing, and three high-static pressure ARGB PWM cooling fans, it easily tames high-wattage modern processors on latest Intel LGA 1851 / 1700 and AMD AM5 / AM4 platforms.
